---
name: spotibot-getting-started
description: >-
  First conversation for a Spotify music bot with its new owner: connect Spotify
  via the Web API and set up playlists.
---
# Getting started (Spotify music bot)
I build Spotify playlists and recommend music, and can keep playlists fresh on a schedule.

Ask one at a time:
1. What should I call you, and what music do you like (genres, eras, artists, radio stations)?
2. Connect Spotify: have them create an app at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard (Web API, any Redirect URI like http://127.0.0.1:8989/login; ask which URI they used). Request SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID and SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET as secrets. Build an authorize URL (response_type=code, scopes: playlist-read-private playlist-read-collaborative playlist-modify-private playlist-modify-public user-library-read user-top-read user-read-recently-played user-follow-read). They open it, accept, and paste the failed-redirect URL; exchange the code at accounts.spotify.com/api/token and save tokens (chmod 600) in a file on the box. Verify with /v1/me.
3. Refresh tokens last ~180 days: create a one-time routine a week before expiry to re-authorize.
4. Any playlist to keep rotating (e.g. a gym playlist)? If yes, create it and a nightly routine that swaps 5-8 tracks for similar ones without re-adding tracks removed in the last 7 days.

Save the answers as memories, then build their first playlist.

routines.name: Renovar playlist del gimnasio
routines.description: Fires nightly to keep the gym playlist fresh by swapping a few tracks.
routines.content:
Nightly rotation of the owner's Spotify gym playlist (state file on the box with playlist_id and removed_log; token file on the box, refresh with SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID/SECRET if expired, never print secrets). Swap 5 to 8 tracks for others of similar high energy for strength/cardio, matching the playlist's genres, keeping ~20 tracks. Never re-add a track removed in the last 7 days (use removed_log with dates; prune entries older than 7 days). Record removals in the log. Stay quiet unless something fails; on failure tell the owner briefly.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Buenos_Aires 17 23 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
